baseline_models.focus_anchor: ترقى ... ولن نؤمن لرقيك حتى تنزل علينا كتابا نقرؤه
baseline_models.mechanism: The demand fixes an upward route, declares that ascent insufficient, then requires a downward payload and reserves its verification to the audience. Belief is the withheld payoff of a test whose route, object, and judge are all demand-controlled.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise ascent supplies the upward leg and makes the messenger's movement the first test.
Heart-settled assent is explicitly deferred, making belief the withheld payoff.
Caused descent supplies the return leg, so ascent counts only if it delivers an object.
The written document supplies a bounded, inspectable payload.
Reading supplies audience-controlled verification at the end of the route.

changed_reading.before: A request for ascent and a readable book.
changed_reading.after: A nested test in which ascent is predeclared insufficient: the audience controls route, payload, and verification, so belief can remain deferred.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بيت من زخرف ... سبحان ربي هل كنت إلا بشرا رسولا
baseline_models.mechanism: Elite dwelling, gold, and sky-height recode messenger credentials as visible possession and sovereign capacity. The reply assigns transcendence and lordship upward while retaining for the speaker the embodied office of carrying a message.

activation_trace.role: The house as a seat of honor makes rank and pedigree part of the demanded credential.
Gold makes that rank materially visible and possessable.
The over-arching sky supplies the inaccessible domain whose mastery is demanded.
Transcendent exoneration refuses to transfer divine capacity to the human speaker.
Lordship and sovereign ownership identify where the demanded capacity properly belongs.
Visible-skinned humanity fixes the speaker inside ordinary embodiment.
The message-carrier branch defines the office without converting its bearer into the sender.

changed_reading.before: The speaker modestly says that he is only human.
changed_reading.after: The closing formula exposes a category substitution: the demanded credentials belong to lordship and status, while the speaker's office is human message-bearing.

baseline_models.mechanism: The requested proof must be delivered onto the audience as a bounded inscription and then gathered into reading by them. This changes evidentiary custody from a messenger-carried saying to an audience-possessed document.

activation_trace.role: Placement into a designated station makes the audience the required destination of proof.
Joining parts into a whole gives the evidence a bounded documentary form.
Gathering and assembling makes the audience's reading the act that constitutes the proof as a whole.
Literal reading puts interpretation and inspection in the demanders' hands.
A bearer of carried speech supplies the personal medium that the documentary demand tries to supersede.

changed_reading.before: They ask for an additional revelation.
changed_reading.after: They seek a change of evidentiary custody: from a human carrier's utterance to a bounded document delivered to them and read under their control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence establishes worship, makes dawn recitation witnessed, and leaves elevation to a praised station to the Lord. The focus demand turns that vertical pattern into a spectator-controlled climb whose value depends on returning with a prop.

activation_trace.role: Undertaking and preserving an obligation supplies the disciplined base of the earlier vertical sequence.
Prayer as binding worship makes ascent-related standing answer to devotion rather than display.
Recitation is already enacted in a public temporal setting before the demanded private document.
Presence with witnessing supplies recognition without the audience scripting a spectacle.
Arousing the still supplies elevation whose initiating agency is divine.
A granted station supplies the destination, contrasting with a route prescribed by challengers.
Being found praiseworthy supplies the station's evaluative quality rather than material glitter.
The focus ascent is the shared vertical anchor that the context recasts.

structural_cues: 17:78-79 move from established worship and witnessed dawn recitation to the Lord's possible raising of the addressee.
17:93 reverses agency: the audience specifies both the ascent and the payload that must return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, witnessed recitation, divine raising, and a praised station; I infer a counterpattern to audience-mandated ascent. A live alternative is that the two sequences are only adjacent contrasts, not a deliberate structural reversal.

changed_reading.before: The ascent is simply one more miracle demand.
changed_reading.after: The ascent is a distorted vertical itinerary: worship, witnessed recitation, and divinely granted station are replaced by a commanded climb and an audience-owned return object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context already presents the Quran as descending, readable, therapeutically active, potentially withdrawable, collectively inimitable, and repeatedly varied. The requested book therefore answers no simple absence; it replaces an available revelation with a bespoke delivery whose conditions the rejecters own.

activation_trace.role: The focus document is the supposedly missing object that the context tests against an already operative text.
Actual conveyance downward identifies the Quran as already occupying the requested descent channel.
The named recitation supplies an already readable and recited medium.
Healing makes the descended text functionally active rather than evidentially absent.
Divine imparting identifies the existing content as a gift that can be withdrawn, not audience property.
Collective gathering scales the evidentiary field beyond a private inspection demand.
Likeness supplies the failed public comparison against the existing Quran.
Repeated turning through forms supplies evidentiary variation before the demand.
Refusal after that variation identifies rejection, not missing access, as the live blockage.

structural_cues: 17:82 identifies the Quran itself as presently descending and gives opposite outcomes according to its recipient.
17:88-89 place collective failure and refusal after the existing Quran and its varied examples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an existing descended Quran, its effects, the imitation challenge, variation, and refusal; I infer that the focus demand substitutes controlled delivery for unavailable proof. A live alternative is that the challengers distinguish a heavenly physical manuscript from the recited Quran.

changed_reading.before: The challengers await a readable proof that has not yet arrived.
changed_reading.after: They stand inside an already descending and readable revelation but demand a privately staged hard-copy descent, shifting the issue from evidence to control of evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered demands move from opening earth and producing water, to enclosed abundance, to dropping the sky and staging a face-to-face heavenly encounter, then to gold, ascent, and a delivered book. Each new material or spatial achievement becomes the platform for another condition.

activation_trace.role: A broad fissure and outflow opens the ladder with forced transformation of the ground.
A spring emerging from its source makes controlled provision the first demanded result.
A tree-covered garden escalates a single water source into owned, enclosed abundance.
A river cutting through earth turns provision into a fully engineered landscape.
Downward collapse shifts the test from productive earth to destructive mastery of heaven.
Detached pieces make the sky a manipulable payload before the focus asks for another payload.
Face-to-face confrontation turns divine and angelic presence into another staged encounter.
Ascent carries the ladder upward but is immediately denied finality.
A further caused descent adds a fresh condition after the ascent itself.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 accumulate alternatives and conditions: spring, garden and rivers, falling sky or heavenly retinue, gold house or ascent and book.
Within 17:93, even completed ascent is not sufficient without a further descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered accumulation and the nested final condition; I infer a moving threshold designed to preserve refusal. A live alternative is a rhetorical catalogue of independent requests rather than a deliberate non-falsifiable sequence.

changed_reading.after: 17:93 is the climax of an escalating test ladder in which every concession can generate a new requirement and belief never has to become due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayat name humanity itself as the stated obstacle, then answer with a habitat counterfactual: settled walkers on earth receive a messenger suited to that mode of life. The focus demand is therefore not just excessive; it tries to force the messenger out of the recipient-matched medium that makes transmission possible.

activation_trace.role: Embodied humanity is the focus premise that the following context interprets.
Message-bearing defines a relational office whose medium must reach its recipients.
A barrier between people and belief names the human-messenger objection as obstruction.
Sending and directing an envoy frames humanity as a feature of dispatch, not a failed credential.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the recipients' habitat.
Angelic beings occupy both sides of the counterfactual, matching recipient kind to messenger kind.
Walking supplies the embodied mode of life to which a messenger must be accessible.
Settled tranquility makes the hypothetical inhabitants native to earth rather than visiting spectacles.
Sending an angel down only to angelic earth-dwellers makes descent serve medium-recipient fit.

structural_cues: 17:94 names the human-messenger premise as the stated obstacle after guidance has arrived.
17:95 uses a habitat counterfactual: settled walkers on earth would receive an angelic messenger from heaven only if they were angels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the objection and the angel-on-earth counterfactual; I infer a medium-recipient matching rule that explains the focus reply. A live alternative is that 17:95 only rebuts angelic-messenger demands without proposing a general transmission principle.

changed_reading.before: Humanity is merely a limitation confessed by the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Human embodiment is the messenger's recipient-matched qualification; forcing him into a heavenly species-performance would break the communicative fit the mission requires.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding frame locates compelling authority in truthful entry and exit, lets truth displace falsehood by arrival, and ends with God's sufficient, informed sight as witness. This turns the focus reply from generic modesty into a jurisdictional correction: the messenger speaks and carries; the Lord authorizes and witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Compelling proof is requested from the Lord as support, not manufactured as personal spectacle.
Stable truth supplies the operative evidentiary force.
Falsehood's vanishing makes truth's arrival, not display wealth, the causal victory.
Transcendent exoneration marks the boundary against assigning spectacle-production to the envoy.
Sovereign lordship identifies the proper source of authority.
Sufficiency in undertaking makes divine witness enough without satisfying the challengers' display protocol.
Knowledge-grounded testimony supplies the final court of verification.
Knowledge of inward reality defeats a proof regime restricted to surfaces.
Heart-sight completes the contrast between informed witness and demanded visual display.

structural_cues: 17:80 asks the Lord for supporting authority; 17:81 lets truth's arrival remove falsehood.
17:96 closes the exchange with God as sufficient witness, inwardly informed and seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Lord-given authority, truth's victory, and sufficient divine witness; I infer a jurisdictional allocation between sender and envoy. A live alternative is that these are independent assurances rather than one role-boundary mechanism.

changed_reading.before: سبحان ربي is a pious refusal to perform.
changed_reading.after: It is a jurisdictional correction: spectacle, authorization, and final witness belong to the Lord, while the human messenger's task is truthful transmission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because رقي in 17:93 grammatically denotes ascent, not incantation. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit incantation branch and is activated by Quran-as-healing in 17:82. Render only as a root-branch echo that may color the demand, never as the lexical translation of رقيك.

activation_trace.role: Protective spoken incantation supplies a branch-distant oral-efficacy echo inside the explicit ascent root.
Healing activates the incantatory branch without changing the focus word's grammatical sense.
Quranic recitation joins healing to an already operative oral-textual medium.
The demanders' own reading turns that oral efficacy into an inspectable act they control.

changed_reading.before: The demanded ascent is purely spatial.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory echo, the wording also stages distrust of mediated oral efficacy: a healing recitation is displaced by a document the challengers insist on reading themselves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-contextual gold branch of ذهب beside its actual departure sense in 17:86; it does not claim that 17:86 lexically means gold. It remains anchored in the focus's زخرف and كتاب. Render only as a material pun contrasting possessable display with withdrawable revelation.

activation_trace.role: Gold ornament supplies the focus demand's durable, possessable display value.
The gold branch creates a material hinge with زخرف while remaining secondary to the occurrence's departure sense.
Going away supplies the actual withdrawal motion that makes revelation non-possessable.
Divine imparting identifies what can be removed despite the challengers' attempt to demand custody.
A written object supplies the second possessable form sought alongside gold.

changed_reading.before: The gold house is an independent luxury demand.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material hinge, gold and the demanded manuscript try to solidify into property what the context presents as a revelation that can depart.

strongest_changes: The requested book is not missing revelation but an attempt to replace an already descended, readable Quran with audience-controlled delivery and verification.
The focus ayah is the climax of an escalating test ladder whose nested final condition can keep belief indefinitely deferred.
The human-messenger close is a recipient-fit principle and a jurisdictional boundary, not merely a confession of inability.
summary.what_was_special: Earlier witnessed recitation and divinely granted elevation provide a counterpattern to the challengers' scripted ascent, while the following habitat argument explains why human message-bearing is a qualification rather than a defect.
remaining_uncertainties: The worship-to-praised-station sequence may be a deliberate counterpattern or only a strong contextual contrast.
The exact documentary demand may target a physical heavenly manuscript, a bespoke revelation, or both.
The incantation and gold/departure readings are associative branch activations, not lexical replacements.
